description: Inspect profitability and balance-sheet ratios computed only from matching verified SEC financial measurement periods. Gross, operating, net and cash-flow margins, liabilities/assets, long-term debt/assets and cash/long-term debt retain source inputs and dates. Mismatched or unknown periods remain unknown. No stock price, valuation multiple, analyst estimate, score or buy verdict.
name: get_financial_quality
title: Check financial quality
